name: My Pet Illya
source:
Chapter 4 of My pet series Fate edition.
As soon as Sakura gets destroyed, Saber, Rider and Shiro are hunted down. Ilya attacks the abandoned ruins where enemy resides with the help of her mighty berserker. But she loses and meets the same fate as previously captured girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
